description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named FragmentTabs that demonstrates how to implement action bar tabs and their interaction with fragments. It includes a nested generic TabListener class that manages fragment attachment and detachment when tabs are selected, unselected, or reselected. The activity sets up multiple tabs corresponding to different fragments and preserves the selected tab state.

classes.name: FragmentTabs
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating action bar tabs with fragment management.

classes.name: FragmentTabs.TabListener
classes.description: A generic implementation of ActionBar.TabListener that manages fragment lifecycle in response to tab selection events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the action bar with tabs, and restores the selected tab state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the currently selected tab index to preserve state during configuration changes.
